verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents per-order APIs (decisions, chargeback events, representment outcomes) and marketing claims about approval and authorization rates. It contains no reporting dashboard, no metrics for dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift or review workload, and no export capability. Per-order APIs are developer building blocks from which a user would have to construct the metrics, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see the numbers that matter — dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, review workload — and export them for the board
